findings.title: PR body skips the template's Purpose, Approach and Checklist sections
findings.body: Read: the body uses Summary/Problem/How it's fixed/Changes headings instead of `.github/pull_request_template.md`'s `## Purpose` (with `Fixes #N` or a reason), `## Approach` and the checklist. Map the existing text onto those sections.
